body:
The approved mobile/API journeys had defects in OAuth callback admission, conflict recovery, preparation timing, privacy receipts, historical result labels, and history pagination. This draft repairs those paths and the final four reproduced failures: a wrong returned OAuth callback reaching token exchange; current numeric research results failing cloud export; the first HR result arriving in an already-mounted screen without display admission; and a connected signed reader being shown as unavailable. It also tightens accessibility behavior, native timing evidence, model-evaluation assertions, and complete web-asset verification.

Tested source: `e89897cc852a111b131eaf5c2caaf163ef201a48`. All seven required local gates passed with an unchanged source fingerprint, and all fourteen [CI jobs](https://github.com/R3fresh-dev/One-The-Go-Detection/actions/runs/40185247204) passed an identical merge tree. Local evidence includes 1,538 named API tests plus 208 successful subtests (89.93% coverage), 394 mobile tests (91.20%), 1,508 PostgreSQL tests, 80 component/browser tests, two authenticated live journeys, and real worker interruption/retry/dead-letter checks. The 400-request performance run measured p95 949.6 ms and p99 1237.9 ms. Native builds/core fixtures, firmware/protected-SDK builds and infrastructure checks passed at their documented scope.

Six independent reviewers completed 282 per-spec decisions: narrow software PASS for OTGD-002/004/007 and 44 BLOCKED scopes. The complete 782-case audit records 260 scoped PASS, 420 PARTIAL, 82 BLOCKED and 20 NOT_RUN; these are evidence dispositions, not bug counts. Exact software acceptance gaps remain alongside native OS, hardware, scientific, study and deployment prerequisites. The independent final council assessment is active; application completion and release approval are not claimed.

Run `otgd-20261025-0555`; Factory `4770878e18e9c587c2961b9e2bb13315da31abe9`; correction round 2/2, recovery attempts 0. [Verified evidence checkpoint 13](https://github.com/R3fresh-dev/One-The-Go-Detection/blob/1470d467e7b4e0e80bd5f1f796e71405bb2117ec/docs/factory/otgd-20261025-0555/status.md), [case audit](https://github.com/R3fresh-dev/One-The-Go-Detection/blob/1470d467e7b4e0e80bd5f1f796e71405bb2117ec/docs/factory/otgd-20261025-0555/reports/candidate-e89897c/verification/report.md) and [six-review index](https://github.com/R3fresh-dev/One-The-Go-Detection/blob/1470d467e7b4e0e80bd5f1f796e71405bb2117ec/docs/factory/otgd-20261025-0555/reports/candidate-e89897c/final-six-reviews.json) are on the linked metadata-only evidence branch. The PR source branch remains at the exact tested commit; the evidence commit is not separately claimed application-tested.

Measurement mode stays the default, fixtures remain fictional, and research eligibility requires independent current authority. The future calibrated fuel-cell breath-alcohol channel remains separately scoped in mg/L. No software test establishes sensor/clinical qualification, participant authorization or fitness to drive. Draft only; no merge, deployment or release requested.
